subject: Private Offer passback / margin reconciliation — ops questions
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>, ben.carter@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private Offer passback / margin reconciliation — ops questions

Hi Laura (and team),

Thanks for the call earlier. A few operational items we need to nail down before we finalize the private offer for AWS Marketplace:

• Passback vs. rebate: do you want the reseller (Tidewater) to be paid as a passback on invoice lines, or do you prefer a post-billing rebate?
• List-price floor: our legal/finance asks for a 5% list-price floor to preserve marketplace compliance. Tidewater mentioned they need an 8% channel margin — can you confirm if this is non-negotiable?
• Reporting cadence: monthly invoice-level reporting to track passbacks and marketplace fees (CSV preferred).

I've attached a draft PO that reflects the initial commercial terms we discussed (acme_po_draft.xlsx). Ben and Marcus are looped for margin/fee accounting. If you can confirm the preferred passback mechanism and whether Tidewater will accept a 5% floor with a complementary rebate structure, we can produce the DocuSign-ready PO by Monday.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Marketplace Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: acme_po_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@tidewater.io, support@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer passback / margin reconciliation — ops questions

Hi Soojin — thanks for the note and the draft PO. Quick clarifications from our side:  

1) Tidewater is pushing for an 8% margin as part of their resale economics. They are open to either a passback or a rebate as long as accounting can reconcile it on a monthly basis.
2) We prefer passback on invoice lines (simpler for our AP), but we need the invoice to include the partner allocation line items so our procurement team can validate.
3) Tax handling: are marketplace fees grossed up or netted before passback? Our tax team needs to see an example invoice line.

If you share the invoice example and the CSV format for the monthly reporting, I can get procurement and Tidewater to sign off quickly.

-Laura
Laura Chen
Head of Cloud Procurement, Acme Corp
Attachment: (none)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer passback / margin reconciliation — ops questions

Looping in a quick commercial proposal from our side so Laura/Tidewater know the shape we can accept: 

Proposal (Redwood):
- Marketplace list-price floor: 5% (this is to preserve SKU parity and avoid listing violations).
- Tidewater target margin: 8% gross — we propose a hybrid structure: 5% guaranteed passback on invoice + a quarterly performance rebate up to an additional 3% if Tidewater drives >$150k net new usage in the quarter.
- Marketplace fees: bill gross, Redwood will provide line-item fee breakdown in the monthly CSV so Acme can net/passback correctly.

Rationale: this keeps the marketplace compliant, gives Tidewater a path to their 8% economics, and limits Redwood downside on list-price erosion. If Acme insists on an 8% guaranteed passback, finance will need to reprice the PO (impact to northern-sku tiers).

HubSpot Deal: https://hubspot.example/deal/9643

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer passback / margin reconciliation — ops questions

Thanks — a few finance/ops notes so the accounting team at Acme knows what to expect: 

• Marketplace fee handling: we'll provide a CSV with the following columns: invoice_id, sku, usage_units, list_price, marketplace_fee, net_to_redwood, passback_amount, partner_id. Example attached.
• Tax treatment: marketplace fees are deducted before passback calculation. Passback is calculated on net_to_redwood (post-fees, pre-tax). If Acme requires taxes to be handled differently, we need a signed statement from their tax team.
• Revenue recognition: Redwood will invoice Acme gross; the passback will be processed as a contra-revenue line item on the same invoice. We will provide GL mappings if your accounting needs them.

Attachment: marketplace_fee_breakdown.csv (sample CSV)

If that approach works, legal can finalize the DocuSign-ready PO after we agree passback/rebate details.

Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer passback / margin reconciliation — ops questions

Great — thanks everyone for the clarifications. Summarizing agreed next steps so we can close the PO this week: 

1) Acme confirms passback mechanism: invoice-line passback (preferred). Please confirm by EOD Tue.
2) Tidewater accepts hybrid economics: 5% guaranteed passback + up to 3% quarterly rebate based on new usage thresholds. If Tidewater requires a firm 8% guaranteed passback, notify us immediately — finance will need to reprice.
3) Redwood (Marcus) to deliver sample CSV + example invoice (attached).
4) Once Acme confirms, Redwood legal will circulate DocuSign PO (link below) for signature.

DocuSign PO (preview): https://docusign.example/sign/ACME-RDW-PO-2027
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/deal/9643

If I don’t hear any objections, I’ll generate the final PO and route to DocuSign by Wednesday morning.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Director, Marketplace Sales
Redwood Inference
